title: SharePoint: organisation-wide page templates managed from the brand center
summary: The briefing accurately reports the roadmap plan and distinguishes existing brand center controls from undocumented page-template controls. Minor corrections should acknowledge SharePoint's published baseline licensing requirement, complete the setup route, and reconcile the site-owner checklist with the controls table.

claims.where: controls[0].ui; Governance guidance: Before rollout; Governance controls table
claims.claim: Microsoft 365 admin center > Settings > Org settings > Brand center reaches the brand center setup page.
claims.quote: In the admin center, go to Settings > Org settings. Select Brand center. Confirm the existing organization assets site that the brand center recognizes. Activate the brand center app for your organization.
claims.fix: The path is correct but stops on the setup page. For an existing organization-assets site, extend it to 'Settings > Org settings > Brand center > Activate the brand center app'; for a tenant without organization assets, use 'Settings > Org settings > Brand center > Create the site'. State in the note that setup follows the applicable tenant scenario at https://learn.microsoft.com/sharepoint/brand-center-overview.

claims.where: controls[0].api; controls[0].note; Governance controls table
claims.claim: Remove-SPOOrgAssetsLibrary -BrandCenter is a SharePoint Online PowerShell call that deactivates Brand Center features for the tenant, as the row's note specifies.
claims.quote: When used with the -BrandCenter parameter, this cmdlet removes Brand Center related organization assets libraries and deactivates Brand Center features for the tenant.

claims.where: controls[0].note; Governance controls; Open questions

claims.where: front matter: licensing.model; licensing.notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: Licensing is reported as unknown because no entitlement specific to organization-wide page templates is published.
claims.quote: To access SharePoint, users in your organization need to be assigned a license that includes SharePoint.
claims.fix: Set licensing.model to 'included' under the standard's product-level licensing rule. Begin licensing.notes and Cost and licensing with 'To access SharePoint, users in your organisation need to be assigned a licence that includes SharePoint. Requirements specific to organisation-wide page templates are not yet published at the time of writing (November 2026).' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/office365/servicedescriptions/sharepoint-online-service-description/sharepoint-online-service-description. Keep the narrower unpublished feature-price and meter statements.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: The supplied roadmap record names no licence, price or meter for the feature.
claims.quote: these templates help authors reduce repetitive setup and create pages with consistent content.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: The brand center setup steps name the Global Administrator role but list no licence prerequisite.
claims.quote: Searched: 'SharePoint Online licensing requirements users SharePoint brand center page templates'; opened brand-center-overview and read all three setup scenarios. Their steps name a Global Administrator, site setup and CDN choices, but no licence prerequisite.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: No price or meter specific to organization-wide page templates is documented at the time of writing.
claims.quote: Searched: 'SharePoint organization-wide page templates default permissions prerequisite brand center licensing pricing'; opened brand-center-overview and SharePoint service description. Neither publishes a price or meter specific to these page templates.

claims.where: Cost and licensing
claims.claim: The brand center overview does not describe a charge for brand center setup.
claims.quote: Searched: 'SharePoint Online licensing requirements users SharePoint brand center page templates'; opened and read brand-center-overview, including Setting up the brand center. That page describes setup actions but states no setup charge.

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; Why it matters; rationale: risk; Open questions
claims.claim: Microsoft has not stated the default arrival behavior of organization-wide page templates, so defaultState is unknown.
claims.quote: Searched: 'SharePoint organization-wide page templates default permissions prerequisite brand center licensing pricing'; read the roadmap record and brand-center-overview. Neither states automatic availability, required publication or an enablement default for these page templates.

claims.where: Why it matters; rationale: impact
claims.claim: No source located states that this feature changes existing page creation or existing pages.
claims.quote: Searched: '"organization-wide" "page templates" SharePoint brand center'; read the roadmap description and brand-center-overview. They do not describe replacement of existing page creation, changes to existing pages or a change to default behavior.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure
claims.claim: The roadmap does not specify what template content can be included or who can read it across sites.
claims.quote: enabling organizations to provide reusable, approved starting points for page creation across sites within a tenant.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions; rationale: risk
claims.claim: The roadmap describes no agent, automation, background action or new data access for this feature.
claims.quote: Managed centrally in the SharePoint site associated with your organization's brand center, these templates help authors reduce repetitive setup and create pages with consistent content.

claims.where: Governance controls
claims.claim: The brand center overview names the SharePoint admin center as a surface for updating brand center site permissions.
claims.quote: From the Brand center associated site, SharePoint site owners and above can update the site permissions in the SharePoint Admin Center such as adding more brand managers to the experience.

claims.where: Governance controls
claims.claim: The brand center overview itself gives no step-by-step SharePoint admin center navigation path for site permissions.
claims.quote: Searched: read brand-center-overview's Managing the brand center section for permissions navigation. It names the SharePoint Admin Center and adding members to the site owners' group but supplies no label-by-label admin-center route.

claims.where: Scope; Governance controls; Open questions
claims.claim: Microsoft has not stated that an activated, working brand center is a prerequisite for organization-wide page templates.
claims.quote: Searched: 'SharePoint organization-wide page templates default permissions prerequisite brand center licensing pricing'; read roadmap record and brand-center-overview. The roadmap identifies the management site, but neither source requires app activation for these templates.

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment: Security & identity
claims.claim: The centrally managed template content sits under the control of the people who manage the associated SharePoint site.
claims.quote: Site owners have full control of the SharePoint site.
claims.fix: Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/sharepoint/site-permissions for the site-control premise. Narrow 'It also puts a new piece of central content, the templates, under the control of whoever manages the brand center site' to 'The roadmap places template management in the associated SharePoint site; site owners have full control of that site.' Keep the separate uncertainty over feature-specific creation and approval roles.

claims.where: Governance controls
claims.claim: Brand center enablement is the existing documented control identified by the roadmap's association with the brand center, rather than a confirmed page-template switch.
claims.quote: Searched: 'SharePoint organization wide page templates Set-SPOTenant Set-SPOOrgAssetsLibrary enable disable API'; opened brand-center-overview, Remove-SPOOrgAssetsLibrary and Set-SPOOrgAssetsLibrary. Existing brand controls are documented; no feature-specific enablement link is stated.

claims.where: controls[1]; Governance controls; Governance controls table
claims.claim: No separate UI switch or automation setting for organization-wide page templates is documented at the time of writing.
claims.quote: Searched: 'SharePoint organization wide page templates Set-SPOTenant Set-SPOOrgAssetsLibrary enable disable API'; read brand-center-overview and Set-SPOOrgAssetsLibrary. Results describe other template types, not a separate control for these page templates.

claims.where: Governance guidance: Before rollout; Governance controls
claims.claim: The checklist tells readers to review brand center site owners, but that permissions control has no controls-table row.
claims.quote: Review the owners of the brand center site, because the brand center page says they can use the app ... That page names the SharePoint admin center for permissions but gives no step-by-step path, so it is not a table row.
claims.fix: The Before rollout instruction to review the brand center site's owners has no matching table row. Remove that checklist bullet; retain the existing permissions explanation in Governance controls. Do not add an unverified control row.
